one_liner: Cloud-based accounting software platform for small and medium-sized businesses with robust APIs.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 with standard authorization code flow.
gate_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Xero account and create an OAuth 2.0 application.
verdict_reason: Xero offers a comprehensive public REST API with standard OAuth 2.0 authentication and self-serve developer access.

extras.rate_limit_note: Standard Xero API rate limits apply (e.g., 60 requests per minute per tenant).

evidence.quote: The Accounting API exposes accounting and related functions of the main Xero application and can be used for a variety of purposes such as creating transactions
